steps.en: Install the desktop app (macOS/Windows) — or attach your agent instead
steps.zh: 装桌面应用（macOS/Windows），或直接把 agent 接上

steps.en: Pick an artifact type, a plugin/skill and one of the 151 DESIGN.md systems, enter a brief
steps.zh: 选产物类型、插件与一套 DESIGN.md 设计系统，写简报

steps.en: Spawns a coding-agent CLI already on your PATH — or streams your BYOK endpoint
steps.zh: 启动你 PATH 上已有的编码 agent CLI，或走你的 BYOK 端点

steps.en: The agent composes skill + template + brand contract into real HTML/CSS files, previewed in a sandboxed iframe
steps.zh: 把 Skill、模板与品牌契约组装成真实项目文件，沙箱里预览

steps.en: Iterate in Studio, then export the artifact
steps.zh: 在 Studio 里迭代，导出成品

value.en: Prototypes, decks and videos as real files on your machine — no hosted studio, no model lock-in
value.zh: 原型、deck、视频都以真实文件留在本机——不用托管工作室，不锁模型

sources: https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design#product-tour (Home: artifact type + brief + design system; Studio iterate & export)
https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design#architecture (daemon spawns cli with cwd; sandboxed iframe; 127.0.0.1; BYOK proxy)
